phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official React, Next.js, and web.dev performance sources were checked before local planning.

phases.label: Root architecture audit
phases.bottleneck_notes: Large MonitorShell inspection and chunk string inspection identified the first safe boundary.

phases.label: Dynamic boundary implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Implementation was small because ToolStudioPanel was already a separate file.

phases.label: Verification and package build
phases.bottleneck_notes: Renderer build, Playwright/Chromium audits, and Tauri package build dominated elapsed time.

phases.label: Evaluation records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Requirements, spec, omission, resource, and evaluation records were created.

bottleneck_analysis.notes: The package build remains the longest step and is intentional due to the user's automatic build preference.
